This reflex is also referred to as the atrial reflex [p.839]. It is triggered by increased venous return, which stretches the atrial walls and activates baroreceptors, leading to an increase in heart rate through sympathetic stimulation [p.831].

results.question: Autonomic reflex that responds to stretch receptors in the atria that send impulses to the cardioaccelerator area to increase HR when venous flow into the
results.answer:
The autonomic reflex that responds to stretch receptors in the atria to increase HR when venous flow into the atria increases is called the Bainbridge reflex. [p.839]
**从功能上看**，this reflex is triggered when increased venous return stretches the atrial walls, activating baroreceptors that send signals to the cardioaccelerator area in the brainstem. [p.831] This area then increases sympathetic stimulation to the heart, leading to a rise in heart rate. [p.831]
The reflex is part of the autonomic nervous system and operates independently of conscious control. [p.839] It ensures that the heart rate increases when there is a surge in blood returning to the atria, such as during physical activity or when blood volume rises. [p.831] This helps maintain adequate cardiac output and blood pressure. [p.839]

results.question: C-h f 用来查什么？
results.answer:
C-h f 是 Emacs 中用于查找命令（function）文档的快捷键，它会根据输入的命令名显示对应的文档字符串，该字符串通常位于函数定义的参数列表之后，用于描述命令的功能和用法 [p.8]。 当你知道某个命令的名字，但不确定它的具体用法时，可以通过 C-h f 快速获取帮助信息。 例如，如果你输入 C-h f set-fill-column，Emacs 会显示该命令的文档字符串，告诉你它如何设置填充列的宽度。

此外，C-h f 的使用方式与其他帮助命令类似，比如 C-h v 用于查找变量的文档，而 C-h a 则可以通过正则表达式模糊查找命令名。 如果你不确定命令的完整名称，但记得部分关键字，C-h a 会是一个更灵活的选择。 不过，C-h f 的优势在于它直接针对命令的文档，适合需要明确命令名的情况。

results.question: Autonomic reflex that responds to stretch receptors in the atria that send impulses to the cardioaccelerator area to increase HR when venous flow into the
results.answer:
Bainbridge reflex
The Bainbridge reflex is an autonomic reflex that responds to stretch receptors in the atria, sending impulses to the cardioaccelerator area to increase heart rate when venous flow into the atria increases [p.839].

This reflex is triggered when there is an increase in venous return to the atria, which stretches the atrial walls. The cardioaccelerator area, part of the autonomic nervous system, responds by increasing sympathetic stimulation to the heart, which in turn raises the heart rate. This mechanism helps to ensure that the heart can meet the increased demand for blood flow during conditions such as exercise or when there is a sudden increase in venous return. While both reflexes are involved in regulating heart rate, the Bainbridge reflex specifically relates to changes in atrial stretch due to venous return.

The Bainbridge reflex operates without direct nervous or endocrine control, relying solely on the mechanical stretching of the atria and the subsequent activation of baroreceptors. The reflex is particularly relevant in situations where there is a rapid change in venous return, such as during physical activity or when there is a sudden shift in body position.

In summary, the Bainbridge reflex is a key autonomic response that ensures the heart can adapt to increased venous return by increasing heart rate, thereby maintaining adequate cardiac output.

results.question: C-h f 用来查什么？
results.answer:
**从功能上看**，C-h f 是 Emacs 中用于查找命令（function）文档的快捷键，它会显示该命令的详细说明，包括其用途、参数以及相关示例。 [p.6] 如果用户不确定命令的完整名称，也可以使用 C-h a 或 M-x apropos 来通过正则表达式或关键字模糊查找相关的命令。 [p.6] 如果用户需要查找变量或函数的信息，可以使用 C-h v 或 C-h f 的组合，或者使用 M-x apropos 来查找所有匹配的函数、变量或命令。 [p.6]

此外，Emacs 的帮助系统非常强大，除了 C-h f 之外，还有许多其他帮助命令，例如 C-h m 用于查看当前 mode 的帮助信息，C-h C-h 用于列出所有帮助相关的选项，C-h i 用于打开 Emacs 的 Info 文档等。 [p.6]
